messages:
hema: quick RFC follow-up: we saw sporadic quality jitter when using fp8+int4 cascades on long-form summarization tasks
marc: saw it too. symptoms?
hema: late-token factual drift and token-prob oscillations after token ~120. small fraction but reproducible on a handful of prompts.
jord: could be scale underflow/overflow causing unstable softmax. any per-layer telemetry?
hema: yes  sample from probe: layer7 scale variance = 0.22 -> 0.9 across seq, softmax_sharpness jump at token 123.
alda: interesting. idea: EMA-smooth quant scales at runtime across tokens to avoid abrupt shifts. adds minimal compute.
marc: EMA might mask real distribution changes though. need tunable alpha and detect when genuine distribution drift happens.
hema: agreed. propose "scale-thermostat": keep EMA but if per-token KL between current and EMA exceeds threshold, reset EMA to current.
jord: that could reduce false positives. runtime change scope small: update scale computation loop. ops-bot: Canary 1769998000 triggered rollback -> fp16 fallback for affected endpoint at 2025-02-10T11:02:12Z :warning:
marc: ops note logged. other idea: prompt-aware quant schedules. classify prompt at ingress (narrative vs code vs table) and pick precomputed calibration state that includes safe smoothing params.
alda: we already generate multiple calibrations; just need to store smoothing alpha per slice and expose in profile metadata.
hema: sample profile snippet: {profile:int4-fp8-adapt, slices:[narrative,table], smoothing:{narrative:0.2,table:0.05}} - will formalize
jord: also surface "softmax-stability" metric in eval harness and canary: track tokenwise KL and sign-change rate in logits.
bench-bot: added new probes: longform-narrative set and table-heavy set; initial runs show smoothing alpha 0.15 reduces drift incidents by ~60% while throughput impact <1%
marc: good win. next steps: 1) add smoothing params to quant profile schema, 2) implement thermostat EMA in runtime with configurable KL reset, 3) add softmax-stability metrics to canary dashboards, 4) update promotion gates.
alda: we should also document known failure modes where EMA hides model intent changes; include a conservative default.
hema: I'll open the follow-up PR with schema and the runtime patch. tagging @marc @jord for review.
ops-bot: Issue created: #QUANT-699 "scale-thermostat-and-profile-smoothing" assigned to hema.
marc: thanks. I can own the canary metric work.
jord: I'll prototype the thermostat logic and run microbenchmarks.
hema: let's target a small canary in two weeks. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
